name: Sakurabashi Miria
source: A popular idol who transfers to Usagino high school with her twin sister Yuria. Though she pretends to be a sweet and demure girl for her fans she's actually quite mean and a sadist. Miria has been thoroughly training her twin sister into a proper young lady. When she finally gets her own bunny suit it reflects her personality with traits of a sadist queen.
